youtube.title: Morning Prayer for Today | Psalm 30:5 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. If last night was a long night, hear this.

"For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning." Psalm 30:5 (KJV)

For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life:

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.
